_comment: Local-only Emulator Suite config for `npm run emulators`. Run with --project demo-accessbelt
(the demo- prefix makes it impossible for the emulators to reach production).
This file must never be passed to `firebase deploy`; CI deploys firebase.json only.
LIMITATION (firebase-tools 13.x): the emulator loads rules for the (default) database only.
Named databases (accessbelt-operator, accessbelt-agency) run with NO security rules here,
so operator-database rules (events, broadcasts, closures, activity) are NOT exercised locally.
The array form of `firestore` is NOT used: in 13.35 it silently loads no rules at all and the
emulator then allows every read and write, which would hide rules bugs.
